text:
mina: FYI deploybot placed a sticky pin on runtime-3.5 after seeing elevated memory OOMs in the 'summarize-plus' model group. We need to coordinate a scoped unpin during the maintenance window and define a decay policy.

deploybot: [automated] sticky pin applied. pin_id=pb-2024-12-02-07. Affected: model-group 'summarize-plus' (summarize-v2, summarize-x). Trigger: OOM events > 2.5% (10m). See internal pin page for details.

jared: Trace snippets show regressions primarily on background batch jobs that use large contexts and high batch size. Interactive short queries look OK.

fiona: Proposal: scoped unpin that excludes hosts labeled `tenant:dedicated` and filters traffic to max_seq<=4096 and batch_size<=8. Canary in us-east.

sam: Agree. Also recommend a sticky->soft auto-decay: after 6h sticky becomes soft; soft auto-unpin after 24h if metrics remain under thresholds. Ops, can deploybot enforce that?

ops-sre-bot: Runbook updated: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/pinning. Example canary command: `deploybot unpin --pin pb-2024-12-02-07 --scope region:us-east --traffic-filter 'max_seq<=4096 AND batch_size<=8 AND tenant:!=dedicated' --mode canary`. Monitored signals: `oom_rate`, `crash_rate`, `p95_latency`, `error_rate`.

mina: Rollback criteria suggestion: any of the following within 20m -> rollback: oom_rate > 0.5%, crash_rate increase > 1pp, p95 latency > baseline * 1.15. If we hit partial instability, fall back to runtime-3.4 for affected routes.

jared: I'll prepare a short smoke script to run against canary hosts with header `X-Canary-Pin:pb-2024-12-02-07`. Will post shortly.

fiona: I'll own the canary monitoring and decision. Scheduled window: canary unpin 23:45 UTC -> monitor 20m -> decision 00:10 -> expand 00:30 -> full unwind target 01:30.

sam: I'll add ephemeral dashboards and an alert `pin_decay_needs_rollback` if oom_rate spikes >0.6% after unpin.

deploybot: I can schedule the scoped canary unpin at 23:45 UTC. React with :white_check_mark: to approve automated run.

mina: Approved. :white_check_mark:

ops-sre-bot: Ops checklist:
1) tag canary hosts `pin_canary=pb-2024-12-02-07`
2) run canary unpin command at 23:45 UTC
3) run jared's smoke script and monitor `oom_rate`, `crash_rate`, `p95_latency` for 20m
4) decision point at +25m -> expand or rollback
5) if rollback -> `deploybot pin --pin pb-2024-12-02-07 --force` and notify #customers and oncall

jared: smoke script (short):
```bash
for i in {1..200}; do
  curl -s -H "X-Canary-Pin: pb-2024-12-02-07" \
    "https://canary-east/api/generate?model=summarize-v2&max_seq=1024&batch_size=4" > out.$i.json &
done
wait
# quick check
jq -s '[.[]] | {errors: map(select(.status!=200))|length, p95: (map(.latency)|sort)[int(length*0.95)]}' out.*.json
```

fiona: I'll update the release notes and ping PMs and CS with the targeted window. Draft note: "Temporary sticky pin pb-2024-12-02-07 applied to runtime-3.5 for summarize-plus due to OOMs on large batch/long contexts. Scoped canary unpin planned; dedicated tenants excluded."

mina: Thanks all. We'll reconvene here with canary results. If anything deviates we rollback immediately and log in incident tracker.
